### Feature Summary
One sentence describing the desired capability.

### Build Plan Phase Alignment
- **Target Phase:** Phase N (from `docs/04_ECFD_Build_Plan.md`)

### Proposed Architecture & Interface
Describe any API routes, contracts, or UI components involved.

- [ ] Unit & integration tests added
